senses.gloss: (b. h., Pilp. of גלל)to roll, turn. Pirké́ d’R. El. ch. XXXVI לגַלְגֵּל וכ׳ to roll (move) the stone.—
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 3:3:6">Y. Sabb. III, 6ᵃ</cite> top <he>מְגַלְגְּלִין ביצה וכ׳</he> you may roll an egg (for roasting) on &c.
Ḥall. III, 1 גִּלְגְּלָה (בחטים) when she has formed the dough (of wheat) by rolling; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Pesachim 7a:4">Pes. 7ᵃ</cite> <he>עיסה מג׳</he> a formed dough.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sotah 1:2:7">Y. Sot. I, 16ᶜ</cite> bot. <he>ביצים מג׳</he> roasted eggs; a. fr.

B. Bath. 16ᵇ מה עדשה זו מְגוּלְגֶּלֶת אף אבילות מִגַּלְגֶּלֶת וכ׳ as the lentil is rounded, so does mourning roll and go around (different version in Ms., v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note, a. in Yalk. Gen. 110, v. גַּלְגַּל). [Men. 86ᵃ, v. גִּרְגֵּר.].—2) (with על) to roll upon, to put on one’s shoulders, to burden, tax, assess.

<cite ref="Mishnah Ketubot 8:1">Keth. VIII, 1</cite> (<cite ref="Ketubot 78a:2">78ᵃ</cite>) <he>אתם מגלגלים עלינו וכ׳</he> you burden us with old restrictive laws. Y. Shebi. IV, 35ᵇ <he>אתם מג׳ וכ׳</he> ye impose upon us taxes &c.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Bava Batra 1:3:1">Y. B. Bath. I, beg. 12ᵈ</cite> <he>מג׳ עליו וכ׳</he> you make him bear the expenses for &c.
<cite ref="Shabbat 32a">Sabb. 32ᵃ</cite>; Tosef. Yoma V (IV), 12 <he>מגלגלין זכות ע״י וכ׳</he> good things are brought about through the agency of good men &c.; a. fr.

senses.gloss: (v. גָּלַל Nif.) to overcome (one’s own feelings), to put up with, bear with.
units: <cite ref="Ketubot 67b:5">Keth. 67ᵇ</cite> <he>רצונך שתְּגַלְגֵּל עמי בעדשים</he> will you bear with me when I offer you only lentils? <he>ג׳ עמו וכ׳</he> he tried to live with him on lentils, and died.
<cite ref="Ketubot 111a:24">Ib. 111ᵃ</cite> <he>ג׳ בעצמו</he> he conquered his love and remained single. Y. ib. VII, beg. 31ᵇ <he>מגלגלת עמו וכ׳</he> she has to bear with him thirty days longer.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Yevamot 8:1:6">Y. Yeb. VIII, 8ᵈ</cite> top <he>גַּלְגֵּל עמהן וכ׳</he> bear with them twelve months (give them time for reconsideration).
<cite ref="Mishnah Eruvin 10:3">Erub. X, 3</cite> <he>נ׳ הספר מידו</he> the scroll rolled out of his hands (down the roof).

<cite ref="Mishnah Challah 3:1">Ḥall. III, 1</cite> <he>עד שתִּתְגַּלְגֵּל בחטים</he> in the case of wheat flour, until it (the dough) is rolled, v. supra. Y. Kil. IX, 32ᶜ top; Y. Keth. XII, 35ᵇ top <he>מִתְגַּלְגְּלִין</he> their bodies are rolled underground, v. <cite ref="C00864"><he>גִּלְגּוּל</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Bava Kamma 17b:18">B. Kam. 17ᵇ</cite> <he>ונתג׳ למקום אחר</he> but the barrel rolled to another place.
<cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 6:1">Pesik. R. s. 6</cite> <he>מא״י נִתְגַּלְגְלָה וכ׳</he> from Palestine it (the stone) rolled and arrived just for this momentary use; a. fr.
<cite ref="Pirkei DeRabbi Eliezer 49:13">Pirké d’R. El. ch. XLIX</cite> <he>נתגלגלה המלכות על וכ׳</he> the royal dignity was transferred on Esther.

<cite ref="Mishnah Shevuot 7:8">Shebu. VII, 8</cite> <he>נ׳ לו שבועה וכ׳</he> if by chance an oath is imposed upon him in another law-suit (with the same persons), the court makes him swear by implication &c.; v. <cite ref="C00864"><he>גִּלְגּוּל</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Pirkei DeRabbi Eliezer 5">Pirké d’R. El. ch. V</cite>; ch. XXIII.
<cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 20:1">Pesik. R. s. 20</cite> <he>נִתְגַּלְגְּלוּ רחמיו וכ׳</he> the Lord’s compassion was moved. Tanḥ. Vayigg. 4; a. e.

senses.gloss: to throw one’s self upon, to attack.
units: <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 350">Yalk. Is. 350</cite> (<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 288">ib. 288</cite> <he>נתגאה</he>).
